rows.factor: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

rows.label: Annualised Alpha
rows.description: Jensen alpha annualised — return beyond benchmark-beta prediction.

rows.label: Information Ratio
rows.description: Active return divided by tracking error — (R − Rb) / σ(R − Rb). Skill measure relative to benchmark.

rows.label: Tracking Error
rows.description: Annualised stdev of active return vs benchmark — σ(R − Rb).

rows.label: Monthly Hit Rate
rows.description: Share of calendar months with positive return. Persistence indicator; SOW target ≥ 55%.

rows.label: Regression Fit (R²)
rows.description: Coefficient of determination of the multi-factor regression — fraction of return variance explained by the chosen factor set.

rows.label: Gross Exposure
rows.description: Sum of absolute notional values across positions divided by AUM. Schedule A caps this for leverage control.

rows.label: Net Exposure
rows.description: Signed notional sum (longs minus shorts) over AUM. Bounds long/short directional bias.

rows.label: Single-Name Concentration
rows.description: Largest absolute single-position weight as a fraction of gross exposure. Schedule A caps this for idiosyncratic risk.

rows.label: Max Drawdown
rows.description: Worst peak-to-trough cumulative loss in the lookback window. Negative values; closer to zero is better.

rows.label: Value-at-Risk (95%)
rows.description: Historical-simulation 1-day VaR at 95% confidence as a fraction of AUM. Negative; closer to zero is safer.

rows.label: Sharpe Ratio
rows.description: Excess return per unit of total volatility — (R − Rf) / σ. Higher is better; SOW threshold for hire is > 1.0.

rows.label: Annualised Return
rows.description: Geometric mean of daily returns scaled to 252 trading days. Captures the central tendency of return generation.

rows.label: Max Drawdown
rows.description: Worst peak-to-trough cumulative loss in the lookback window. Negative values; closer to zero is better.

rows.label: Annualised Volatility
rows.description: Standard deviation of daily returns × √252. Total realised risk over the lookback window.

rows.label: Jensen's Alpha
rows.description: Intercept of CAPM single-factor regression — return in excess of what beta exposure to the benchmark would predict.

rows.label: Benchmark Beta
rows.description: Sensitivity to benchmark from the CAPM single-factor regression.

rows.label: Monthly Hit Rate
rows.description: Share of calendar months with positive return. Persistence indicator; SOW target ≥ 55%.

rows.label: YTD Return
rows.description: Compound return since 1 Jan of the most recent calendar year in the window.

rows.label: Drawdown / Vol Ratio
rows.description: |Max drawdown| divided by annualised volatility. Risk-of-ruin scaler; lower is better.

rows.label: Best Month
rows.description: Largest single-month return in the lookback window.

rows.label: Worst Month
rows.description: Worst single-month return in the lookback window.

rows.label: Avg Fund Correlation
rows.description: Mean correlation of the candidate fund's returns to existing funds in the proposed pool. The penalty-zone threshold caps this for diversification.

attrs.verdict: Diversifying. Correlation 0.00 comfortably below 0.60. Sharpe Δ +0.00, ENS Δ +0.97, Vol Δ +0.00%.

rows.label: Predicted Annualised Volatility
rows.description: Total predicted portfolio volatility (annualised) from factor exposures + specific risk. √(factor variance + specific variance) × √252.

rows.label: Factor Risk Share
rows.description: Share of total predicted variance attributable to factor exposures.

rows.label: Specific Risk Share
rows.description: Share of total predicted variance attributable to instrument-specific (residual / idiosyncratic) risk.

rows.label: Predicted Annualised Volatility
rows.description: Total predicted portfolio volatility (annualised) from factor exposures + specific risk. √(factor variance + specific variance) × √252.

rows.description: Share of total predicted variance attributable to factor exposures.
